*'''Intro if you're not receiving an item:'''</br>''Listen to the soil, biped, for it speaks volumes. *'''Intro if you're receiving an item:'''</br>''The soil tells me a new year must be upon us, and with that comes the dawn of the earthwyrm!''</br>''As one of the first to pay respects to us, your subterranean masters, we deign to provide you with this morsel of ancient wyrm knowledge.''

*''We wyrms can dry off on the surface when rain threatens to drown us in our underground lair.''</br>''Such is but a glimpse into our greatness.''
*''We wyrms are so prolific that we thrive not only in Vana'diel, but on a planet called Earth as well!''</br>''Such is but a glimpse into our greatness.''
*''We wyrms excrete half our body weight every day, yet it exudes no odor and enriches the soil!''</br>''Such is but a glimpse into our greatness.''
*''We wyrms are born without the cowardly ability to retreat. We march forward no matter the danger!''</br>''Such is but a glimpse into our greatness.''
*''We wyrms are useful in catching more than mere fish when used as bait.''</br>''Such is but a glimpse into our greatness.''

=== Dialogue ===
''I remember 20 years ago when I was in charge of protecting Galkan Bridge from the beastmen. ''
''For a large part of the [[Crystal War]], we had her blocked off on both sides. The government said it was to keep enemy spies from infiltrating Bastok's central areas. However, there was rumor that it was to prevent Galka from coming over on this side of the river and rioting.''
''It would be a lie if I told you it wasn't hard for me, a Galka, to work against my brothers like that.''
''I still have nightmares about the time I had to force back groups of refugees trying to escape the flames that engulfed their homes in the mines district.''
''And now I'm back here patrolling the bridge as I did long ago. Perhaps destiny has a tighter grip on us than I thought...''
